title: Microsoft 365 admin center: high-usage Copilot users list in Billing & usage
notes: claim 47: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft has not explained how assigning a Copilot licence affects metered usage, but Microsoft documents an exemption for specified agent activities under the licensed user's authenticated identity. The existing licence-assignment and report-privacy controls are supported; the new page's default and its own controls remain undocumented.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not say what assigning a Copilot licence does to a user's metered usage.
claims.quote: If you have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, using agents in Copilot Chat, Microsoft Teams, or SharePoint for classic answers, generative answers, or Microsoft Graph tenant grounding isn't charged when the agent runs with your authenticated identity.
claims.fix: Replace the broad absence in Why it matters with: 'Microsoft documents that Microsoft 365 Copilot licence holders are not charged for classic answers, generative answers or Microsoft Graph tenant grounding by agents in Copilot Chat, Teams or SharePoint when the agent runs with their authenticated identity. Whether the new page's purchase action eliminates all of a listed user's charges is not yet documented.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing. Narrow the repeated cost, checklist and open-question statements to whether that purchase action eliminates all charges.
